justification: Assessment returned INVALID, localized the flaw to step 0009/0010 (the sub-claim 'otherwise n+i <= lcm(1,...,k)' gives no contradiction when i = 0 and n = lcm(1,...,k), because the hypothesis is non-strict n >= lcm), which is verbatim the ground-truth flaw. It supplied both ground-truth witnesses: k = 3, n = 6 ([6,9] has only 7 with a prime factor > 3, count 1 < required 2) and k = 2, n = 2 ([2,4] has only 3, count 1 < 2). Both check out arithmetically: 6 = 2*3, 8 = 2^3, 9 = 3^2, pi(3) = 2, k+1-pi(k) = 2.
